verdict.rationale: The EC&VC practice page explicitly states support 'from incorporation through to exit' and describes a dedicated team for high-growth companies, indicating incorporation work is within scope. However, there is no specific mention of charter/bylaws drafting, board consents, or founder stock purchase agreements as concrete deliverables — missing for 10: detailed incorporation-document workflow (articles/bylaws templates, board consent process, founder stock purchase agreement), and any client testimonial or case study specifically about a formation engagement.
